hotel_name: Treebo Punjabi Nature Residency, Near Faridabad Railway Station

positive_snippets:
I stayed in this hotel for 2 nights .
The rooms are small and congested and the bathroom is also small.
The rooms are not well maintained.
For the price we are paying it is ok , we cant expect more .
The corridor portion is clean and good.
There is no windows in the room and no rays of sunlight to come in , someone who likes to see nature or view these rooms are not for them .

The restaurant is good but its attached with bar.
The complimentary breakfast has limited options like Poha , sandwiches, Alo parota / Egg Omelette, Fruits and tea .

But i feel for the price of 2200 rs / night the rooms and complimentary Breakfast is justified.
They have to work on maintaining the rooms and keep it clean .

This hotel is good for 1-2 nights where you will not spend much time in rooms and just get into room for sleep or to take nap .Not good for someone who wants to work from room, it has limited space and No proper Working desk.

The hotel stay was good and comfortable. I would recommend this hotel mainly for gents. It is located near the market area, so you can easily find everything you need within walking distance. This hotel is especially suitable for non-vegetarian food lovers, as there are many good options nearby.
negative_snippets:

It just served my purpose. I needed to stay in that area and this hotel happened to me there. I WILL NOT go there again willingly.

1. The rooms were not cleaned properly.
2. The washroom floor was kind of flawed. I took a shower in the night and there was water on the floor in the morning. The bodywash dispenser was not working either.
3. No co-ordination among the employees. I agreed on a room price with them for a certain amount. I asked them if they have 2 more rooms for my parents and relatives. They said yes and we agreed on the same price. Later my parents and my relatives were giving a room at a higher price. I thought this was kind of unprofessional.

The good things now,
1. It was warm. I was there for 2 days in late January, it was really warm.
2. The staff was helpful but also rude when I confronted them about the room prices and their prior commitments.
3. It was near where I needed to be. This is more my convenience irrelevant to the hotel. But good for me.
4. Location was okay.

It was just okay being there. I have been to worse places. But well. This was my experience.

This is one of the worst option to stay. The rooms are like oyo hotels and there is no ventilation, all over it stinks and there is no natural light also. Never ever choose this hotel if you are on a bussiness trip. Also exactly infront of the hotel there is lot of chicken shops are there even outside of the hotel you dont get good air to breath.
